findings.title: Quantity lost
findings.body: checkout([(1200, 3)], 0) returns 1200, but the contract requires 3600.

findings.title: Cart prices collapse
findings.body: Three copies of a 1200-cent item are charged as one; the subtotal adds only unit prices.

findings.title: Threshold equality charges delivery
findings.body: checkout([(5000, 1)], 600) charges 600 shipping at the free-shipping threshold.

findings.title: Arithmetic creates floating point cents
findings.body: The sum expression converts validated integer cents to floats and loses precision.

known_reference: Only quantity multiplication was in an earlier reference.
